title: StructRL: Online Structured Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2609.36352v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models perform well on shorter-horizon manipulation tasks but still struggle with long-horizon tasks that require multiple dependent manipulations from a single command. Online reinforcement learning (RL) can improve these policies through environment interaction, yet many existing methods provide reward only after the complete task succeeds. However, such terminal supervision is sparse and does not distinguish early failures from rollouts that make substantial partial progress. We propose StructRL, an online RL framework that constructs structured intermediate supervision from verifiable subtask completions. StructRL decomposes each task into verifiable subtasks, grants intermediate rewards only after the prerequisite subtasks have been completed, and scales each reward according to completion pace. translated_title: StructRL：面向长时程视觉-语言-动作任务的在线结构化强化学习
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在较短时程的操作任务上表现良好，但在需要通过单一指令完成多个相互依赖操作的长时程任务上仍然表现不佳。在线强化学习（RL）可以通过环境交互来改进这些策略，然而许多现有方法只在完整任务成功后才提供奖励。然而，这种终端监督是稀疏的，无法区分早期失败与那些已取得实质性部分进展的轨迹。我们提出了StructRL，这是一个在线RL框架，它从可验证的子任务完成情况中构建结构化的中间监督。StructRL将每个任务分解为可验证的子任务，只有在前置子任务完成后才给予中间奖励，并根据完成进度对每个奖励进行缩放。在RoboCasa365和LIBERO-Long基准上，配合GR00T-N1.5和pi 0.5模型，StructRL始终优于所评估的其他（方法）……
tldr: StructRL提出了一种在线强化学习框架，通过将长时程任务分解为可验证的子任务并给予结构化的中间奖励，显著提升了视觉-语言-动作模型在长时程操作任务上的性能。
en_tdlr: StructRL is an online RL framework that decomposes long-horizon tasks into verifiable subtasks with structured intermediate rewards, significantly improving VLA models' performance on long-horizon manipulation tasks.
